title: Tech Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:- Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
- Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
- Praticar escuta ativa,acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
- Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
- Implementar práticas eferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
- Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
- Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
- Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
- Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
- Identificar pontos demelhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
- Apoiar a estruturaçãoe reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
- Remover impedimentos egarantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:- Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
- Conhecimento em OKRs epráticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
- Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
- Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
- Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
- Habilidade para atuarcom métricas de performance e cultura de times.Requisitos desejáveis:- Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
- Experiência como AgileCoach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
- Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
- Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
- Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.- Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAISAntes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.Dito isso, oferecemos:● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;
● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
● Programa +Vantagens, amaior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;
● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
● Plano de saúde e odontológico;
● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
● Vale transporte;
●Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
● Espaço de lactário;
● Bicicletário;
● Vestiário;
● Seguro de vida;
● Auxílio creche;
●Previdência privada;
● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
● Gympass.Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.#Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica:Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINARESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).Certificações:Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description: IMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements. Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards. Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines. Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above. Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently. Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Accounting Manager
description: This role is for the person who: Wants to help founders of eCommerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials. Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on. Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience. To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.About UpCounting We're afully remote, tech-poweredfirm helpingeCommerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence. Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus. We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department. We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work. We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.What You'll Be Doing Team Leadership:Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work. Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight:Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files. Operational Excellence:Ensure UpCounting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed. Client Support & Communication:Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations. System & Process Optimization:Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.What You Bring 5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment. High proficiency in QuickBooks Online and/or Xero (NetSuite is a bonus). Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you. Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes. Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes. FP&A or financial modeling experience is an asset. A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.Perks & Culture Because great work deserves a great place to do it. Fully Remote + Async Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap. Work from Anywhere We care about outcomes, not location. Paid Time Off Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure. Grow With Us We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact. Continuous Learning We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning. Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.Your Journey at UpCounting Your First Week Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.Month 1 You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.In 3 Months You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.Curious About Our Values & Culture? They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity.Learn more on our Careers Page.How We Hire Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video. Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations. Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team. Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership. Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to UpCounting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Analista De Negócios Digitais | Inovação Em Ia
description: Sobre a Ionix Ajudamos empresas a construir capacidade interna de IA de verdade. Nada de projeto que acaba na gaveta — a gente constrói processo, capacita o time e fica junto até o cliente andar sozinho. Sobre a vaga Buscamos alguém para atuar junto às áreas de negócio dos nossos clientes, identificando oportunidades e construindo soluções com IA e automação. Você vai ser o profissional que faz acontecer: mapeia processo, entende a dor, monta o protótipo, testa e documenta o aprendizado. Não é consultoria de relatório. É mão na massa. O que você vai fazer Entrar nas áreas, conversar com as pessoas, entender como as coisas funcionam de verdade e onde dói. Transformar essas dores em hipóteses claras:\ "se a gente automatizar X, oresultado deve ser Y\ ". Construir protótipos funcionais usando ferramentas como Lovable e Claude Code. Ciclos curtos de 2-4 semanas. Testar, medir, aprender. Funcionou? Escala. Não funcionou? Documenta o porquê e parte pra próxima. Ensinar as pessoas das áreas enquanto trabalha junto. A ideia é deixar capacidade instalada, não criar dependência. Alimentar o repositório de conhecimento com casos, templates e lições aprendidas. O que você precisa ter 2-4 anos de experiência em funções que misturam tecnologia e negócio: analista de processos, analista de sistemas, consultor de transformação digital, product analyst ou algo parecido. Saber usar ferramentas no-code/low-code. Se você já montou automação em N8N, Make ou Zapier, já prototipou em Lovable e Claude Code Conseguir escrever bons prompts para LLMs e entender o que dá pra fazer (e o que não dá) com IA generativa hoje. Noção de API, banco de dados e integração. Não precisa ser dev, mas precisa conseguir fazer as coisas funcionarem e resolver pepino quando trava. Saber conduzir conversa de discovery: perguntar certo, mapear processo, identificar gargalo, estimar impacto. Comunicação boa. Você vai falar com gente de negócio e gente técnica no mesmo dia. Autonomia. Você vai estar atuando remoto, muitas vezes resolvendo sozinho. Precisa saber tomar decisão. Diferenciais Ter algo pra mostrar. Um projeto pessoal, uma automação que você fez, um protótipo que rodou. Qualquer coisa que prove que você constrói. Experiência com Lean Startup, Design Thinking ou Jobs-to-be-Done. Inglês pra consumir documentação e acompanhar o que está saindo de novo. O que você vai encontrar aqui Projetos de transformação em IA com empresas grandes. Exposição a áreas e setores diferentes — você não fica preso numa caixinha. Mentoria de gente sênior em IA e produto. Ambiente onde o que você constrói vira caso, e o que você aprende vira treinamento pra outros. Trabalho 100% remoto. Processo seletivo Conversa inicial pra entender seu momento. Case prático pra ver como você pensa e resolve problema. Papo final com a liderança.

description:

Responsabilidades Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;
Escrever roteiros de vídeos longos para o canal do YouTube da VAROS e/ou dos sócios (8 a 20 minutos), sobre temas de finanças, economia, geopolítica e mercado financeiro;
Escrever roteiros de Reels e TikToks (1 a 3 minutos) adaptando temas complexos para formatos curtos e de alto engajamento;
Manter consistência com o tom de voz da marca: conversacional, didático, com exemplos numéricos concretos em R$, sem jargão desnecessário;
Colaboração com o timede edição no intuito de garantir que a visão do roteiro seja traduzida fielmente para o vídeo final. Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing. Sugerir títulos e ideias de thumbs pensados em engajamento. Requisitos Formação e Experiência Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
3 anos ou maisde experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;

Hard Skills Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos. Excelente habilidade de escrita;

Notion;
IA (Claude, Perplexity);

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets. Knowledge and experience requiered Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools. Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS. Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control. Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment. Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.G., Ansible, Python). Management & communication Skills Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers. Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.G., operations, finance, senior management). Relevant Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations. Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable. ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship. We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing. This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals. Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment. How to Apply: Get your application in now! This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Account Manager
description: As an Account Manager for Brazil, you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments. You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success. Specifically, your role will involve: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor. Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services. Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions. Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts. Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions. Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts. Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments. Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management. Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks. The ideal profile We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions. Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth. Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management. Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events. Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above. Next steps in the process ✅ First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together! What’s in it for you Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Salesforce Consultant

This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud, application administration, integration, and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, or equivalent are highly preferred. Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments. Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms. Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams. Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus. Tools and Technologies: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules) Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi) AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation) Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.G., Jira, Confluence)

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding. In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models. This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines. Key Responsibilities: Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer Required Skills and Qualifications: Core Skills Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills Clear and concise written communication Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness) Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data Behavioral Traits High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset Preferred Backgrounds: Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus Offer Details: Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 4 weeks;
(expected start date isnext week) Evaluation Process: Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Your role and responsabilities: Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution. Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams. Requirements and Qualifications: Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support. Experience in automation and CI/CD practices. Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred). Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk. Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues. Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams. Please submit resumé in English.

title: Coordenador(A) De Operações | Benefícios Seguráveis E Não Seguráveis
description: Coordenador(a) de Operações | Benefícios Seguráveis e Não SeguráveisSobre a IresaSomos uma corretora boutique em ritmo acelerado de crescimento. Nosso DNA une o conhecimento técnico das corretoras tradicionais com a agilidade e modernidade da tecnologia. Somos orientados ao cliente (client first) e utilizamos IA e ferramentas modernas para sustentar nossa estrutura.Vamos além do\ "arroz com feijão\" bem feito: operamos como um braço estratégico do RH, desenvolvendo processos, iniciativas e melhorias que causam impacto real. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨
